breadth.label: Percent of S&P 500 stocks above 50-day MA
breadth.note: Below 30 bullish, above 70 bearish. Computed by Thaddeus from Yahoo Finance daily closes for 502 of 503 current S&P 500 constituents at the Oct. 20 close (mimics MMFI).

fear_greed.commentary: Sentiment edged up from extreme fear to fear at 27 as the Dow rallied more than 1% and yields eased, though it remains well below last month's 34. A tech market still stuck in place keeps investors cautious.

markets.summary: Breadth improved under the surface: the Dow jumped 1.02% to 52,495.88, led by a 5.8% gain in 3M on an expanded Amazon data-center deal and a raised outlook, and the S&P 500 added 0.28% to 7,712.57, while the Nasdaq was flat (-0.02%) as AI-funding worries kept chip stocks in check, with NVDA off 0.29%. Breadth climbed to 52.0% of S&P 500 stocks above their 50-day average from 43.8%. Small caps led, with the Russell 2000 up 1.65% to 2,773. Rates eased a bit as oil pulled back, with the 10-year Treasury yield down about 1.5 basis points to 5.12% and futures pricing only a 17% chance of a Fed hike next week, down from 58% a month ago. Gold futures slipped 0.4% to $4,142.60 while silver rose 1.3% to $57.71; both remain below their 40-week averages.

stories.headline: SpaceX posts first profit as a public company; revenue up 161%
stories.summary: Q3 revenue of $14.6 billion beat the roughly $12.7 billion estimate, driven by its AI segment and Starlink, with net income of $4.4 billion; shares rose about 8% after hours.

stories.headline: Nvidia rises after hours as Musk says SpaceX is adding about 200,000 GPUs a month
stories.summary: On SpaceX's earnings call, Musk said the company is bringing roughly 200,000 Nvidia GB300s online monthly through year-end; NVDA closed down 0.29% at $216.47 but rose about 2% after hours.

stories.headline: Chinese tech giants order $35 billion of Nvidia chips, but supply is tight
stories.summary: ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent ordered more than 3 million RTX PRO 5500 cards, Reuters reported, though Nvidia told partners they may get only 5-10% of what they requested.

stories.headline: Saskatchewan sets a goal of at least 2,600 MW of nuclear power by 2050
stories.summary: Cameco welcomed the province's new plan to make nuclear a core part of its long-term energy supply; the company reports Q3 results on October 30.

weather.summary: The nor'easter off the Mid-Atlantic keeps tracking north and out to sea, so coastal flooding from the Mid-Atlantic to the Northeast should ease through Thursday, though lows near freezing are possible in parts of the Northeast and New England. Out West, a deepening Pacific trough pulls tropical moisture into the Southwest and Four Corners starting Wednesday, with storms capable of scattered flash flooding in central and southern California, the Desert Southwest and the Four Corners, and the threat focused on the Four Corners Thursday. The West turns cooler than normal, while a ridge brings above to well above average warmth to the central US through the weekend; locally, Denver7 expects mid-70s in the metro through Friday before a cooler, wet weekend.
